feature_name: Google GenAI Image Safety Settings Support
description: Update the Google GenAI (Gemini) integration to properly handle safety settings when processing image content. Currently, the system incorrectly applies text-only harm categories to image-based requests, causing API rejection. Implement logic to detect image content and apply appropriate image-specific safety categories while maintaining backward compatibility for text-only requests.
functional_requirements: Detect when a request contains image content and dynamically switch from text-based harm categories (HARM_CATEGORY_*) to image-specific categories (HARM_CATEGORY_IMAGE_*)
Map user-provided text safety thresholds to their corresponding image category equivalents (e.g., HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH → HARM_CATEGORY_IMAGE_HATE)
Ensure safety settings processing occurs after message conversion and multimodal content extraction to accurately detect image presence
Maintain existing text-only safety settings behavior unchanged when no image content is present
